description: Local AI routing gateway with Agent client takeover — reuse existing client logins, call 50+ AI clients through one base URL, with unified OpenAI / Anthropic / Images APIs, multi-account routing, check-in, balance and request reports · 本地 AI 路由网关 + Agent 客户端接管：复用各家客户端登录态，一个 base_url 调用 50+ 家模型额度，统一 OpenAI / Anthropic / 生图接口，多账号选路、签到、余额与请求报表一体管理

latest_release.name: v3.4.2
latest_release.body:
1. 新增：自定义路由组，可将不同提供商、不同模型组合成一个对外模型 ID，配置参与成员、账号顺序与失败后备选。
2. 优化：路由配置恢复“配置列表、当前配置、账号组”的三栏画布布局，默认打开路由配置；配置卡片垂直居中，外层内边距统一为 10px，精简创建弹窗和冗余说明。
3. 优化：模型筛选支持搜索，默认“全部”展示现有账号，选择具体模型后只展示对应账号组；移除配置卡片中的选路预演区域。
4. 优化：请求回放改为简洁列表与执行时间线，按请求当时的快照展示尝试、切换和跳过原因，区分响应到达与首帧时间。
5. 优化：全局默认直接管理账号启用与禁用，与账号页同步并即时生效；其他路由仍独立控制参与名单。旧版全局参与设置转换前列出受影响账号并要求确认。
6. 优化：恢复账号积分到期倒计时、到期近远排序快捷入口，以及整组和单账号设置按钮；消耗规则修改后同步刷新顺序，保留独立路由顺序和未保存的其他修改。
7. 新增：压缩路由，可为 ZCode 上下文压缩请求指定模型，普通对话仍使用原模型。
8. 新增：客户端识别，支持内置规则、自定义规则和来源声明，并在请求记录与报表中展示识别信息。
9. 新增：标准 Windows 服务与 systemd 部署支持面板一键更新，下载后独立校验、备份替换并确认新版启动；安装脚本兼容旧安装接入并保留已有配置。
10. 新增：MonkeyCode 国内版、国际版桌面内嵌网页登录，登录后自动读取凭证，保留用户手动完成页面验证的流程。
11. 优化：签到与领取补充人工验证提示和结果回查，减少重复领取，完善 ZCode 与豆包工作相关记录。
12. 优化：网页搜索可组合标准搜索服务与已有账号能力，支持账号绑定；工具执行增加超时限制。
13. 优化：账号余额展示即将到期份额和倒计时，单位未知、仅提供比例的读数单独标注；Android 手机端支持选择 APK 更新来源。
14. 移除：桌面端与手机端的 LobsterAI 新增账号入口，已有账号的显示与调用保持不变。
15. 更新：同步六语界面文案、六份安装文档及相关打包脚本，重建桌面前端、手机端与多语言资源。
16. 版本：3.4.1 → 3.4.2

# Agent2API **An AI routing gateway with Agent client takeover, unifying model APIs and local client configuration** **English** | [简体中文](./docs/README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./docs/README.zh-Hant.md) | [日本語](./docs/README.ja.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md) | [Português (BR)](./docs/README.pt-BR.md) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-AGPL--3.0-green)](./LICENSE) [![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/aimod-cc/Agent2API?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/aimod-cc/Agent2API/releases/latest) [![docker pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/aimodcc/agent2api)](https://hub.docker.com/r/aimodcc/agent2api) [![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/aimod-cc/Agent2API?style=flat&color=yellow)](https://github.com/aimod-cc/Agent2API/stargazers) [![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux%20%7C%20Docker-blue)](https://github.com/aimod-cc/Agent2API/releases/latest) [✨ Key Features](#-key-features) • [💬 Community & Support](#-community--support) • [🚀 Quick Start](#-quick-start) • [📦 Installation & deployment](./docs/install.en.md) • [📸 Screenshots](#-screenshots) • [🔧 Development & Build](#-development--build) • [📜 Usage Notice](#-usage-notice)
--- Agent2API is an **AI routing gateway with Agent client takeover**. It exposes a unified model API for custom AI providers and centralizes account routing, model mapping, gateway keys and request reports. It also manages local Agent clients' connection profiles, including importing, switching and previewing configuration changes. ## ✨ Key Features - 🔌 **Unified model APIs** — OpenAI Chat / Responses / Images and Anthropic Messages, with a unified model catalog; Raccoon, Loomy, Antigravity, ModelScope, WorkBuddy and Doubao Work supply image generation, while Raccoon, Loomy, Antigravity, ModelScope and WorkBuddy also support reference-image editing. Both are available as AI assistant tools - 🧭 **AI routing** — model mapping, account priority, load balancing, session affinity and failover in one place - 🤖 **Agent client takeover** — manage multiple connection profiles for local clients, import existing settings, preview writes and switch between the gateway and custom services - 🧩 **Plugin extensions** — additional provider implementations are installed and updated separately, not bundled with the application; custom providers do not require them - 🛡️ **Egress proxies** — select proxy-pool exits for accounts and update tasks - 🔑 **Gateway security** — scoped gateway keys, optional human verification for panel sign-in, and model requests refused by default until a key is configured - 📊 **Request reports** — request volume, success rate, token usage, cache hit rate and a 365-day heatmap - ⏰ **Background maintenance** — model catalog refresh, credential maintenance and software update checks; daily check-in runs per provider on that provider's own window (Qoder 10:01, ZCode 19:01, others follow the schedule time), plus a catch-up round that only touches accounts not yet checked in; additional provider-specific tasks are supplied by plugins - 🖥️ **Three deployment forms** — Windows / macOS / Linux desktop apps, headless Windows / Linux servers and Docker (amd64 / arm64); no Node runtime required, with a six-language interface ## ❤️ Sponsors
Thanks to ProxyLane for sponsoring this project! ProxyLane provides native static residential ISP proxies for AI accounts (Static Residential ISP): IPs come from real home broadband operators with low Scamalytics fraud scores, each IP is dedicated to you, with unlimited traffic, from $3.90. Add one exit per account on the Network proxy page. Use code AGENT2API25 for 25% off your first purchase.
## 💬 Community & Support - **QQ groups**: Agent2API chat groups — **group 1 (`1127656296`) and group 2 (`1130894674`) are almost full, please join group 3 (`1108276647`)**; search the number in QQ to join. - **Telegram group**: - **💖 Donate**: if Agent2API helps you, you are welcome to [buy the author a coffee](./docs/SPONSOR.md); donations are voluntary and unlock nothing. - **🤝 Sponsorship / business**: want to sponsor the project, or feature your product here? Email [541675139@qq.com](mailto:541675139@qq.com). ## 🚀 Quick start Three forms — pick the one that matches your setup; **the complete install, upgrade, uninstall and troubleshooting guide is in [Installation & deployment](./docs/install.en.md)**. | Form | Artifact | Interface | | --- | --- | --- | | **Desktop** (Windows / macOS / Linux) | `Agent2API__x64-setup.exe`, `_universal.dmg`, `_amd64.deb`, `_amd64.AppImage` | App window | | **Server** (Windows Server / Linux, headless) | `agent2api-server-windows-amd64.zip`, `agent2api-server-linux-.tar.gz` | Browser panel | | **Docker** | `aimodcc/agent2api:latest` (amd64 / arm64) | Browser panel | **Desktop**: add a custom provider and account, create a gateway key, then apply a connection profile on the Agent page or configure your client with `http://127.0.0.1:3065/v1` and that key. Additional provider capabilities require the corresponding plugin. **Server** (no GUI; registered as a system service and started at boot): ```bash # Linux tar -xzf agent2api-server-linux-amd64.tar.gz && cd agent2api-server-linux-amd64 && sudo bash install.sh ``` ```powershell # Windows Server (administrator PowerShell) Expand-Archive agent2api-server-windows-amd64.zip -DestinationPath C:\agent2api-pkg cd C:\agent2api-pkg; .\install-service.ps1 ``` **Docker**: ```bash docker run -d --name agent2api --restart unless-stopped -p 3065:3065 -v ./data:/data aimodcc/agent2api:latest ``` Whichever form you pick, open the panel afterwards (`http://127.0.0.1:3065/`; use the host IP for the server and Docker forms), register the admin account, then create a key on the "Gateway Keys" page. Connectivity check: `curl http://127.0.0.1:3065/health` **Mobile**: open `http://:3065/m` in a browser (you can "Add to Home Screen" for a full-screen PWA). For a standalone icon, install `Agent2API-.apk` (Android) or `Agent2API-.ipa` (iOS, unsigned — re-sign it yourself) from the Release. Details: [Install & deploy → Mobile](./docs/install.en.md#mobile). ## 📸 Screenshots ### Accounts ![Accounts page: global queue, per-model rate-limit cooldown, expiry and balance](./assets/screenshots/accounts.png) Add account: ![Add account: choose provider and edition, then sign in on the web](./assets/screenshots/add-account.png) ### Model management ![Model management: per-provider model catalog with rate, context and mappings](./assets/screenshots/models.png) ### Report Overview: requests / success rate / tokens / top model, with account and provider rankings, usage donuts and a 365-day activity heatmap: ![Report overview: stat cards, top accounts / providers, model and provider usage donuts](./assets/screenshots/report-overview.png) Trends: 24-hour **cache hit rate** (line) and **token consumption** (area) on twin axes, with a per-day token bar chart below: ![Report trends: dual-axis cache hit rate and token consumption, per-day token bars](./assets/screenshots/report-trends.png) ## 🔧 Development & Build ### Requirements - Rust >= 1.77 and the Tauri 2 toolchain (to compile the desktop app itself; Windows also needs the WebView2 runtime) - Node.js >= 18.17 (only to run `npm run tauri:*` and frontend build scripts; the desktop app does not depend on Node at runtime) - Target platforms: Windows / macOS / Linux desktops, headless Windows / Linux servers, and a Docker server ### Common scripts ```bash npm run tauri:install # Install desktop dependencies (same as npm --prefix desktop-tauri install) npm run tauri:dev # Launch the desktop app in dev mode (with hot reload) npm run tauri:build # Build the desktop installer npm run build:icon # Generate the icon source image (run after changing the icon design, then run tauri icon) ``` The build artifact is `target/release/bundle/nsis/Agent2API__x64-setup.exe` (about 8.6 MB as of 3.0; `src-tauri/.cargo/config.toml` points cargo's `target-dir` at the project root's `target/`). The macOS `.dmg` **can only be built on macOS** (`npm --prefix desktop-tauri run build -- --target universal-apple-darwin`) — it cannot be cross-compiled from Windows, so the official artifact comes from the CI `build` workflow (`macos-latest`, two targets merged). Docker images and the server archives used for in-container updates come from the same workflow's `linux-server` job, which reuses the Dockerfile's compile path so the executable inside is built from the same toolchain as the image. ## 📜 Usage Notice ### Credential and data security Account credentials are encrypted in the local database, but exports, backups and key files may still contain sensitive data. Keep them private; do not upload them to public repositories or cloud storage, or share them with others. ### No warranty The project is provided "as is", without guarantees of availability, stability, security or suitability for a particular purpose. Trademarks and services belong to their respective owners. The complete license and warranty terms are in [LICENSE](./LICENSE). ## 📄 License This project uses the same [GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0)](./LICENSE) as the provider plugin repository. Use, modification and distribution, including commercial use, are permitted under the license. Preserve copyright and license notices and fulfill applicable source-code obligations. If you offer a modified version over a network, you must offer its Corresponding Source to those users. ## ⭐ Star History
